what popular books have you rated one or two stars?

i always feel like i’m reading a completely different book when i give a normally highly rated book two stars… or maybe some people are too nice. for example: i recently finished “The Kiss of Deception” and gave it 2 stars. it was actually terrible but is highly popular on TikTok… i might be at fault here other books i’ve rated two stars: • Twisted Love (awful) • Survive the Night (don’t know how this got approved) • Verity (explanatory) • Animal Farm (controversial i know) what book with an average rating of 4 or more have you rated one or two stars? 0
